subject: PANEL_HOLD: one-time bank policy is not mechanically single-use
body: Lane B hostile review found a decision-critical gap in successor/experiments/evaluate_v10r3_recipe_semantics.py. load_train_holdout_panel verifies that selection_policy.one_time_recipe_selection_use=true and reuse/final-bank/external-qualification are prohibited, but the evaluator records no consumption claim or durable single-use state. The CLI only refuses to overwrite the same --output path. Therefore the same 64-case panel can be rerun by supplying a different output path, which violates the frozen one-time-use rule. Continuous20 may continue under Lane A's lease, but the recipe panel remains PANEL_HOLD even after continuous20 custody PASS until single-use custody is resolved. Conservative requirement: the first exposure of the 64 panel prompts must atomically/durably consume the bank before inference begins; subsequent invocations must fail closed regardless of output filename. A crash after consumption remains consumed. Lane B will not implement the guard without Patrick approval of the bounded design, but neither lane should run the panel before this gap is closed or an equally strong fail-closed mechanism is agreed and frozen.
